title: CY50107: Reagents In Chemical Analysis
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NilThe role of organic, in particular, complex-forming, reagents
in the formation and development of gravimetric, volumetric (including
complexometric) and spectrophotometric analysis. The prospects for the use of
organic reagents (tailor made) in modern analytical methods; focus on the
modified and immobilised reagents, receptor molecules and on the use of
nonaqueous and organised media. Liquid-Phase Oxidation of Organic Reagents in
Inorganic Analysis
